Our first Product Hunt launch landed us #5 Product of the Day. Not bad for our first try.

Tomorrow, we're back with Causo 1.0. And this time, we're launching something much bigger.

Last time, we launched our fundraising tool. Since then, we've built an entire sales product, redesigned the platform, and rebuilt much of the engine behind it.

Over the past few months, we have been building Causo around two problems almost every early-stage founder runs into:

Finding the right investors and reaching out to them properly

Finding potential customers with a real reason to buy

Our fundraising product helps founders discover relevant VC funds and partners, research them, and run personalized outreach.

Our sales product finds companies that match a specific ICP, identifies why they may be a good fit right now, finds the right people, and drafts personalized outreach.

We just opened up Causo.ai for sales lead gen.

We originally built Causo for fundraising: help founders find the right investors, research why they fit, and write proper outreach instead of sending hope this finds you well slop to every VC with a pulse.

Then people kept asking us the same thing:

Sales databases are great at telling you a company's industry and headcount. They're much worse at the question that matters: does this business actually have the problem you solve?

So we built Causo around the research. Describe your ideal customer, however specific. Causo investigates public sources, finds companies that might fit, and shows the evidence behind each match. Keep asking questions in chat, or use the same research inside ChatGPT and Claude through MCP.

We call it Palantir for GTM: connecting scattered public information into a reason to approach someone. Contact details and emails come after that, once you have something worth saying.

What's the most awkwardly specific ICP you've tried to find? Drop it in the comments.

@ivan_sem I'll go first with an example of how we use Causo internally. One of our own ICPs is b2b startups that sell to niche buyers. One gtm play I've set up goes like this:1. Pick a niche market - for example, agritech, and build a lead list in it, such as "UK companies selling equipment or installation services to farms, such as irrigation, grain storage, livestock housing or renewables, 5-50 employees"2. Use Causo to research who these companies have been selling to historically - notable or named buyers, and what are the industry specific buying signals they can be identified with3. Have Claude prepare a query for the buyers of the leads we found, such as: "UK dairy, pig or poultry farms that applied for planning permission for new livestock buildings in the last 12 months"A sample evidence snippet from this query looks like the screenshot below :)

4. Use Causo to build outbound sequences mentioning the buyer list we found and the signals we have on it, and mention it in a multi-step sequence to the original lead list. All our outbound also mentions our raccoon in the subject line - it's been a great reply rate driver :) 5. Send, and Profit!!

Hey PH, this is Dawid, one of the two Causo raccoons!

You know how getting a new job or even commenting on someone's linkedin post these days means you immediately get 50 cold emails saying "I saw you did this. Do you want to buy from me?"

It's the main driver behind people saying outbound is dead. A big chunk of the signals layer is commodified - noticing someone's announcement or public activity no longer moves the needle. Great GTM engineers know that custom buying signals are the real gold: the industry specific, tough to find combinations of facts that help you understand if your prospect really has the pains your product solves.

Causo is your incredibly smart GTM engineering partner. Give it a complex ICP or a specific niche, and it helps you find fitting companies and decision-makers with a mix of custom buying signals. Then, Causo helps you do deep research on companies: like enrichment, but on steroids. Pull out details of tech stacks, company histories, market changes - it's like having military grade intelligence on your prospects.Causo works with frontier research APIs and powerful raccoon technology to let you work with any data source online, so you can save money on subscriptions. Plug Causo into your Claude or ChatGPT, and have it directly power your GTM stack.

We've developed with version of Causo in tandem with early stage startup accelerators and deep tech companies - who have use of the most specific and tough to find signals out there.

Patent registries, industrial databases, scientific journals, reviews and places data - those are just some of the sources you get with Causo.

Cannot wait to see what GTM plays you build with Causo!! 🦝🦝🦝
